highlights.title: Undo a mistake with one click
highlights.body: Deleting a task, gift, vendor or expense, changing an RSVP, or marking a task done now shows an Undo button for 8 seconds, instead of asking you to confirm first.

highlights.title: Email a thank-you straight from a gift
highlights.body: Choose Draft thank-you beside a giver and the message opens with their name and gift filled in. Send it and their Written step is ticked for you. Select several givers to send them all at once.

highlights.title: A gift list you can tick off by hand
highlights.body: The printed gift list is now one compact table with a box for each thank-you written and mailed, amounts lined up, and page numbers. Choose the sort, whether to show addresses, group by type, or print only the thank-yous still to write.
